main_body: Orange-red war drum with a tan drumhead ellipse on top, a cylindrical shell below with gold studs, held on a wooden frame
top_band: Tan/cream drumhead ellipse (light tan highlight at the centre, darker tan edge) at rows ~3-12, about 9 rows tall, ringed by red/gold studs
evidence: Down the middle column: the tan elliptical drumhead (rows 3-12) is a clearly visible horizontal surface with a lighter highlight. Below it a gold stud row marks the front edge at about row 12-13. The orange shell then runs from row 13 to about 21 with a dark red shadow, and a gold-stud band at the bottom. The wooden frame posts and a base beam sit behind and below it. This reads as a correct ellipse-capped cylinder like the green barrel and column in the guide.

style.evidence: The drum body has about 5 orange steps (light left highlight, mid, dark right shadow, deep red) and the drumhead has 3-4 tan steps. Outlines are dark red-brown and brown tinted to the material. The gold studs add detail. The wooden frame is flatter, with only 2-3 browns and little grain, and the lower part of the shell has some smooth gradient areas. Overall it is close to the reference but slightly thinner.
